theme: Quiet until noon, then a run of calls.
greeting: Morning, Dan. The day stays open until noon, then three calls run back to back into mid-afternoon. That clear morning is the best window you'll get this week for the December-trip call, with the book-by date now close.

needsAttention.title: Skim the NACD prep questions before 1
needsAttention.detail: Larissa's Oct 7 reminder for today's 1 PM prep session (the Oct 28 Maine Visionaries event) has the draft question list attached. Ten minutes with it beforehand is the whole point of the call.

needsAttention.title: Tell ICGN what title to run
needsAttention.detail: Claudia at ICGN asked Oct 7 what job title or specialty to list for you in the Toronto programme. A one-line reply unblocks the panel's planning.

needsAttention.title: Make the December-trip call
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board, overdue since Sep 30: the real clock is the Oct 15 book-by for six people over the holidays. Pick domestic vs. international and get a shortlist down this week.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Pathfinder drive dates
needsAttention.detail: The Portland to St Pete drive window is Oct 5-18 and it's live now. Setting dates lets you book the one hotel night and kill the rolling Florida rental cycles behind it.

schedule.title: Call Merrill Lynch
schedule.detail: You set this up last night.

schedule.title: NACD New England prep session
schedule.detail: Zoom; prep for the Oct 28 event.

flagged.title: Valoris follow-up landed
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano at Valoris sent the materials he promised on Oct 7 — unread, worth a look when you have a minute.

flagged.title: Intro to Sun Life's sustainability lead
flagged.detail: Pema introduced you to Marissa Glassbrook at Sun Life on Oct 5; the thread's waiting on your hello back.

flagged.title: A document's waiting for your signature
flagged.detail: A signing reminder came in for 102 26th Ave, St Pete Beach — open it to see what's pending.

resolved.detail: You sent the physician plan-of-care Oct 7; Tampa Gardens has it and is routing it to her doctor — nothing owed.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar before noon — the one genuinely open stretch today.
Three calls land back to back from noon: Merrill Lynch, the NACD prep, then Kevin.
Yours once the calls wrap; the haircut sits tomorrow afternoon, not tonight.
